notes:
Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B); building an in-app conversational support agent + enhanced doc search. Team evaluated Hosted API over 6-week trial.

Hosted API trial summary (concise):
- Duration: 6 weeks (Nov-Jan), prod-sim traffic replay + samples.
- Baseline QPS seen during trial: ~4 qps average during business hours; 95th pct QPS spikes to ~22 qps on weekday afternoons.
- Concurrency: average 12 concurrent requests, normal peaks ~40 concurrent during campaign bursts.
- Token mix observed: ~60% short chats (<200 tokens total), ~30% medium (200-1k), ~10% long/contextual (>1k).
- Avg tokens per request (trial): prompt ~120, completion ~380 -> avg ~500 tokens/req.
- Reranking workload: 1 in 8 queries triggers a rerank flow; rerank multiplies token usage (avg 6 candidates * 120 tokens each for scoring).
- Embeddings: nightly batch for search index updates ~200k documents; embeddings cost/throughput discussed but not part of Dedicated POC scope initially.
- Observed latency targets: product wants 95th < 350ms for short chats, <700ms for contextual flows. Current hosted responses hitting ~280ms median, 95th ~520ms for short flows.
- Cost sensitivity: fairly price conscious; willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit economics predictable and caching/batching reduces token cost.

POC & Dedicated sizing ask (what they requested):
- Redwood to propose Dedicated pool sizing based on trial telemetry: QPS profile + token mix + rerank multiplier.
- Forecast windows: baseline (normal day), peak (promo/campaign peak), growth (12mo).
- POC length: 4-week dedicated POC with failover to Hosted during handoff.
- Success criteria: meet latency SLOs (95th targets) under simulated peak, cost per 1M tokens within target range, predictable autoscaling behavior, KV/prefix caching validation.

Preliminary capacity estimate (Redwood SE notes):
- Workload characteristics: mix of short-turn chat and periodic heavy reranking. Average total token throughput ~2.0M tokens/day baseline (estimated from trial counts). Peak daily throughput ~6-8M tokens with business-hour bursts.
- Concurrency-driven sizing: baseline concurrency ~12, 95th concurrency target to size for ~60 concurrent sessions to cover peak bursts and rerank spikes.
- GPU pool recommendation (initial): 3-4 x A10/A100-class equivalents with continuous batching + prefix caching enabled; plan for autoscale headroom to add 1-2 nodes for campaign peaks.
- Alternative (cost-optimized): 2x higher-quantization instances + heavier caching + lower max concurrency (acceptable w/ some queued requests) to reduce committed cost.

Traffic forecasting details asked by account team:
- Need breakdown: hourly qps profile, token-per-request histogram, rerank fraction, nightly embedding throughput.
- Product provided simulated 7-day traffic replay (drive link above). Redwood to run Dedicated sim to produce expected P95 latency / tokens/sec per GPU.

Security & compliance notes:
- Customer requires SSO (SAML) + audit logs forwarded to Splunk.
- Data residency: customer wants EU residency for EU accounts; initial POC can run NA region for US-only subset, EU rollouts delayed until legal signoff.
- KMS integration required for encryption of model keys.

Commercials & timeline:
- Customer wants a 12-month reserved commitment if Dedicated meets latency/cost targets.
- Estimated ARR for first year: $75k-$150k (negotiable with block pricing for embedding/transfer).
- Forecast close target: 2026-06.

Quotes / direct customer comments captured in call:
- "We need predictable spend — our finance team will only sign if we can model token costs against monthly active users."
- "Reranking is the wildcard — it's cheap for quality but blows up token counts if we don't cache or limit candidates."

Open actions / next steps (short):
- Schedule Dedicated sizing workshop (owner: Jordan) — target week of 2026-03-10.
- Redwood to run sim on replay (SE: Maya) and deliver GPU/sec and cost projections by 2026-03-12.
- Send updated pricing deck + POC SOW (owner: Jordan) — due 2026-03-06.
- Legal to get SOC2 artifact & EU residency answers; customer to route to legal (blocker).

CRM shorthand lines (for AE view):
- AE: Jordan P — hosted trial done, likes latency.
- SE: Maya C — needs to run replay sim, produce detailed GPU sizing + token/sec numbers.
- Finance: expects ARR 75-150k; wants 12mo commit.
- Blocker: legal/residency + SOC2 evidence.
